senses.definition: n.pr.m. (perhaps hireling, Ar. أَجِيرٌ Aramaic אֲגִירָא, ܐܰܓܺܝܪܳܐ v. PS, As. agîru, cf. HptBAS i. 124; others gatherer, fr. i. אגר) son of יָקֶה, an author of proverbs Pr 30:1.
